purpose: Turn a design specification into a realistic price range. Not a firm quote - an educated estimate that gives customers order-of-magnitude clarity before they engage a supplier. Every output must carry the disclaimer that a real quote requires a site survey.
disclaimer: All figures are indicative market-rate estimates for UK 2026-2027. Real quotes depend on site access, specific supplier, regional labour rates, material availability at time of order, and dozens of project-specific factors. This engine gives ranges, not commitments.

material_cost_bands_gbp.note: Per-unit indicative trade prices before installer markup. Retail prices are typically 20-40% higher.

reclaimed_period_oak.note: Highly variable — depends on source and matching

labour_rates_gbp.note: UK 2026-2027 indicative rates. Real quotes vary by region and specific supplier.

labour_hours_by_stair_type.note: Total workshop + install hours for a typical straight domestic flight. Add ~50% for winders / half-turn, ~100% for curved.

winder_stair.notes: Complex geometry - each winder tread individually cut

open_riser_modern.notes: No riser to hide misalignment - more precise install

spiral_kit_assembly.notes: Kit systems can be quicker but limited spec

regional_multipliers.note: Multiply labour totals by regional factor. Materials are more national but delivery adds a small premium.

entry.typical_spec: pine or engineered treads + painted MDF risers + softwood spindles or square metal balusters + basic finish
entry.for_customer: rental properties, first-time renovation, new-build upgrade, functional replacement

mid.typical_spec: European oak treads + painted risers + oak or modern balusters + oil finish + basic under-stair storage
mid.for_customer: family home renovation, thoughtful design without curved/floating spec

premium.typical_spec: American White Oak or walnut treads + glass or premium balustrade + LED lighting + shadow-gap or matching-flooring detail + custom under-stair
premium.for_customer: design-led renovation, high-end family home, first impression matters

luxury.typical_spec: walnut / smoked oak / reclaimed premium timber + frameless glass or curved / floating design + full lighting scheme + statement under-stair feature
luxury.for_customer: architect projects, statement pieces, sub-luxury bespoke

bespoke_luxury.typical_spec: curved or cantilevered engineering + rare timber + custom metalwork + integrated lighting + architectural detail
bespoke_luxury.for_customer: top-of-market homes, developer show pieces, celebrity / heritage restoration

engine_workflow: 2. Compute material list from spec: enumerate treads * count, risers * count, string per flight, newels * count, handrail * metres, balustrade infill * count/metres, balustrade panels * count.
3. Look up each item in material_cost_bands_gbp. Sum low totals and high totals separately.
4. Add labour: match stair_type to labour_hours_by_stair_type, multiply hour ranges by workshop_joiner + installer rates.
5. Apply regional_multipliers based on user postcode.
6. Add finish cost + lighting cost + under_stair cost from bands.
7. Add contingency: 10 percent low end, 15 percent high end (covers unforeseen site work).
8. Add supplier margin: manufacturer typically 25-40 percent gross on total materials + labour.
9. Present three quote tiers (default + one down + one up per design engine convention) with itemised breakdown.
10. Every output ends with: this is an estimate — real quote requires site survey.

example_output_structure.for_design_spec: modern_minimal + mid budget + standard space (13-riser straight staircase in Leeds)
caveats: Assumes straight flight in normal domestic property
Site survey may reveal additional preparation cost
Real supplier pricing varies +/- 20 percent from this estimate

customer_presentation_rules: Always present as a RANGE, never a single number
Always show three tiers (budget / mid / premium equivalents of the spec)
Always itemise materials vs labour vs contingency vs margin
Always cite the disclaimer that this is an estimate not a quote
Always link to nearby suppliers from data/uk-merchant-directory.json for the real quote
not_in_v1: Live pricing feeds from suppliers (needs API integrations)
Regional-specific supplier price variations beyond the multiplier
Currency conversion for country packs (USD, AUD, EUR)
Commercial project pricing (different labour rates + scope)
